pipeline_bootstrap_directive.title: Pipeline Bootstrap Directive
pipeline_bootstrap_directive.rule: At the start of every source-pipeline prompt, load the compact indexes for DOCS.json, WORKFLOW.json, COMMANDS.json, FLOWS.json, and SCRIPTS.json before selecting reads, tools, or execution order. COMMANDS.json and SCRIPTS.json must be loaded into default context as index-only name lists; read their content only when a specific command or script needs exact metadata.

json_source_contract.title: JSON Source Contract
json_source_contract.rule: Source-pipeline structured contracts, packs, templates, eval data, caches, and generated indexes use JSON as the canonical format. JSON may be accepted only as backwards-compatible input for older installed projects.

workflow_workflow_contract.title: Workflow/Workflow Contract
workflow_workflow_contract.rule: WORKFLOW is the unified source for task classification, guardrails, priority steering, and contextual cautions. Do not add a second workflow document for the same purpose.

generic_programming_baseline.title: Generic Programming Baseline
generic_programming_baseline.rule: The code pack is generic software engineering. Game-development behavior is not part of the default programming preload and belongs only to the explicit gamedev project pack.

template_parity_for_reusable_pipeline_im.title: Template Parity For Reusable Pipeline Improvements
template_parity_for_reusable_pipeline_im.rule: When a source-pipeline improvement changes behavior that future installed projects should inherit, update both the executable source contract and the relevant starter template. If the user says 'also improve the template' or equivalent, treat template parity as an active acceptance criterion: update source docs/packs, templates, feature contracts, update protocol notes when relevant, compiled context, and verification together instead of leaving template sync as a follow-up.

project_type_routing.title: Project Type Routing
project_type_routing.rule: Select project packs by project profile. Use gamedev only when the project is explicitly a game, simulation, or game-adjacent interactive project.

finish_contract.title: Finish Contract
finish_contract.rule: Run finalize_task_check_commit_push.py near the end of any changed-file scope that should be committed and pushed. If it fails because tooling assumes legacy formats, fix the owning tool and rerun the finalizer.

tool_error_hardening.title: Tool Error Hardening
tool_error_hardening.rule: When an owned repository script fails because input was easy to pass incorrectly, validation was missing, output was unclear, path/encoding/quoting handling was fragile, or the process failure is likely to recur, default to hardening the owning script, wrapper, help text, validation, or SCRIPTS.json input/output contract before retrying or immediately after unblocking the task. Treat manual recovery as temporary unless the failure is clearly a one-off typo, missing user data, or larger than the current task scope. Prefer file/stdin/structured inputs over fragile inline quoting for complex JSON.

json_structural_edit_tooling.title: JSON Structural Edit Tooling
json_structural_edit_tooling.rule: For JSON edits that only change structure or order, use tools/json/json_node_edit.py or the narrow JSON wrappers instead of manual patching. When one task needs both structural/order changes and content edits, run the scripted structural operation first, then set or patch content. Keep SCRIPTS.json input/output/help metadata current when adding or changing JSON document scripts.

single_entry_tool_handler.title: Single Entry Tool Handler
single_entry_tool_handler.rule: For repository-owned scripts that have a SCRIPTS.json contract and are exposed to agents as repeatable operations, prefer tools/pipeline/tool_handler.py as the public entry point. The handler should validate required and optional parameters from SCRIPTS.json, normalize common aliases, delegate to the target script, capture a predictable result envelope, and automatically log rejected input through tool_error_log.py.

gpt_conversation_input_routing.title: GPT Conversation Input Routing
gpt_conversation_input_routing.rule: When the user provides a ChatGPT shared conversation URL, saved share HTML, or local ChatGPT conversation export/cache and asks to read, search, summarize, analyze, or continue from it, use the dedicated GPT conversation tools first. Use gpt_shared_conversation_extract.py for public chatgpt.com/share links. Use gpt_conversation_archive.py for explicit local private exports/caches with list/search/read/index. Feed the model the extracted Markdown/JSON, not the whole HTML page or entire archive, unless the user explicitly asks for raw source inspection. Do not attempt live private account scraping or session-cookie access.

auto_recovery.title: AUTO Recovery
auto_recovery.rule: Use FLOWS auto_pilot and core/AUTO-PILOT.json. New AUTO grants default to manual transport. Visible foreground AUTO scheduler.bat calls the one-shot checker every600s; closing CMD stops future checks. Never recreate native heartbeat after a manual finalizer; respect account denial before scans/sending. No OS autostart is installed implicitly.
auto_recovery.watchdog_policy: Manual AUTO self-continues immediately in the current chat/turn after a successful finalizer returns continuation.action=continue_current_turn. Refresh source task projection and authoritative native snapshot, then native-begin for each unit with current turn ID + :auto: + completed. Retry the same unit with the same wake ID. STOP, needs_input, batch/queue completion, account limits and project locks stop chaining. No messages to self and no native heartbeat in manual mode. START opens/reuses one visible CMD watchdog; closing CMD stops future recovery checks only. Foreground CMD checks every300s, or600s while the checker reports an account limit (exit10). Python always performs one sweep and exits. Limit data is queried again at most every600s, even when a later reset is known; the clock alone never authorizes sending. Preserve native project/limit checks and OS-locked outbox. Unknown delivery is never automatically retried. Ordinary recovery sends exactly CONTINUE-AUTO to the registered ID. After a previously observed limit and a fresh available account snapshot, send exactly CONTINUE-AUTO (limit reached previously, continue). Persist that prompt in the prepared outbox. The suffix is transport metadata, never prompt_context or a scope change, and does not bypass native-begin. Terminal/input-blocked tasks remain asleep.

token_efficient_tools.title: Conditional Local Code Tools
token_efficient_tools.rule: Before source exploration, verbose CLI output or context export, select the available tool whose trigger matches. This is conditional routing, not six mandatory tool executions per task.

routes.rtk: Supported verbose read-only CLI summaries; retain raw canonical checks, receipts and exit codes.
routes.ast_grep: Structural syntax queries in supported languages; literal names use rg.
routes.serena: Focused semantic symbols/references/implementations through a verified read-only LSP/MCP session.
routes.graphify: Justified repeated cross-file dependency exploration using a fresh bounded local code-only graph.
routes.toon: Selected uniform JSON records when smaller than compact JSON, with round-trip fidelity.
routes.repomix: A genuinely needed bounded multi-file export with explicit scope, security scanning and token budget.

token_efficient_tools.details: Read core/skills/token-efficient-code/SKILL.md in the source checkout, or SocratexAI/core/skills/token-efficient-code/SKILL.md in installed projects, only when invocation details are needed. Resolve real Linux/macOS/Windows executables; do not assume owner paths or an MCP reload in the current session.
token_efficient_tools.fallback: Use a narrow reliable source/rg read when a tool is absent, stale, incomplete or costs more context. State a material fallback once; installation and savings are never inferred.
token_efficient_tools.boundaries: Preserve document readers, canonical gates/finalizers, raw verification and project frozen layers. No automatic full-repo scans/exports, installs, cloud/paid backends or gameplay control.
